title: autoresearch: Autonomous Research Loop with a Local LLM Critic (v1.1)
description: Generalization of the karpathy/autoresearch pattern as a small Python package: any optimization problem expressible as a single metric, a fixed time budget, a single mutable file and a git branch can be optimized iteratively by an LLM critic that proposes one structured change at a time. The critic runs locally via Ollama or against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, the OpenAI API, vLLM, llama.cpp), selected by a provider field with per-provider key resolution, and emits JSON-Schema-constrained proposals (thought_process, alternatives_considered, hypothesis, expected_delta, justification, code_pseudocode, risk_level). The coding agent that applies each proposal to the mutable file is either launched externally or driven by the loop itself: with the coder option enabled, the loop invokes a headless agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) every iteration and advances unattended. The harness commits, runs the experiment under a hard timeout, classifies the result as keep/discard/crash against the running best, advances or resets the git branch, and consolidates a navigable audit log. Ships three working examples (TSP heuristic search, XGBoost hyperparameter tuning, multi-metric scalarization) with sample runs.
